editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout, including the caveats (no simulator yet, Sampler-only scope, no implicit corrections), so nothing here would mislead a learner. "annotations" has three renderings: "annotations" in [19], "אנוטציות" in [23]/[56]/[57], and "הערות" in [70]. "הערות" means notes or comments, which blurs the concept. "directed execution model" is sometimes left in English ([5], [19], [35]) and sometimes translated as "מודל הביצוע המכוון" ([11], [80], [101]). A few phrasings are calques: "הפחתת שגיאות עדינה" for fine-grained mitigation, "הבדל מבני בהיכן ההגדרות שוכנות", and "שנה כיצד shots מבוטאים".

examples.source: error-mitigation choices now live in your annotations and samplex
examples.translation: בחירות הפחתת שגיאות שוכנות כעת בהערות וב-samplex שלך

examples.source: expressed through the directed execution model

examples.suggested: Use one form throughout, e.g. "מודל הביצוע המכוון (directed execution model)" on first mention and the Hebrew after that
examples.why: The term is left in English in [5], [19] and [35] but translated in [11], [80] and [101].

examples.source: Fine-grained, composable error mitigation
examples.translation: הפחתת שגיאות עדינה וניתנת להרכבה
examples.suggested: הפחתת שגיאות מפורטת (ברזולוציה גבוהה) וניתנת להרכבה

examples.source: There is also a structural difference in where settings live.

examples.suggested: יש גם הבדל מבני במקום שבו מוגדרות ההגדרות.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. Precedence rules (num_randomizations * shots_per_randomization גובר על shots), the PEA/PEC requirement, the job-splitting example and the Cliffordization caveats all match the English, so nothing here would mislead a learner. The problems are small phrasing slips. "Measurement noise learning" appears as "למידת רעש מדידה" in [22] and [27], a construct chain that reads as "measurement-noise learning" only with effort; "למידת רעשי מדידה" is clearer. "typed options objects" becomes the stiff "אובייקטי options מסוג מוקלד", "post-processing" becomes the clumsy "עיבוד לאחר מכן (post-processing)", and the imperative is spelled "וודא" in [40] but "ודא" in [51].

examples.source: Measurement noise learning for TREX is still supported.
examples.translation: למידת רעש מדידה עבור TREX עדיין נתמכת.

examples.source: More pre- and post-processing now happens on the client side
examples.translation: כעת מתבצע יותר עיבוד מקדים ועיבוד לאחר מכן (post-processing) בצד הלקוח
examples.suggested: כעת מתבצע יותר עיבוד מקדים ועיבוד משלים בצד הלקוח

examples.source: Make sure you use the submit-all-then-collect pattern

editor_note: The meaning is accurate throughout and nothing would mislead a learner. The compatibility claims ([10], [35]), the underscore-vs-hyphen note ([28]) and the Estimator restriction to two-qubit Pauli-Lindblad layers ([38]) all match the English. Three small fixes are worth making. "method" is split between שיטה and מתודות, even within [17]. "annotated boxes" becomes קופסאות מוערות, a stiff calque where מסומנות would read better, and "boxed" is ממוסגרות while "box" is קופסה elsewhere. [36] drops the definite article in "Estimator הישן".

examples.source: The `NoiseLearner` `run()` method takes ... Convenience methods are available for generating the annotated boxes
examples.translation: השיטה `run()` של `NoiseLearner` ... קיימות מתודות עזר ליצירת הקופסאות המוערות

examples.why: 'method' is rendered two ways in one entry (שיטה and מתודות). Also, מוערות ('commented') is a calque for 'annotated'. Here it means 'marked with an annotation'.

examples.source: `NoiseLearner`, when working with legacy server-side Estimator:
examples.translation: `NoiseLearner`, כאשר עובדים עם Estimator הישן בצד השרת:
examples.suggested: `NoiseLearner`, כאשר עובדים עם ה-Estimator הישן בצד השרת:
examples.why: The adjective הישן is definite but the noun has no article. That is ungrammatical, and it is inconsistent with [10] and [35], which use ה-`Estimator` הישן.

examples.source: defined by how the instructions are boxed and annotated
examples.translation: מוגדרת על ידי האופן שבו ההוראות ממוסגרות ומוערות

editor_note: The meaning holds in every entry, so nothing here would mislead a learner. The Estimator precision/shots caveat in [4], the stale-noise-model caveat in [7] ("מודל רעש מתיישן... מעשי רק אם אין עיכוב ארוך") and the error-mitigation cost warning in [6] all match the English. There are two small naturalness problems. The description in [0] copies "amount of usage spent" word for word as "כמות השימוש המושקע", which reads stiffly. [0] and [3] also use "בעיבוד והרצת עבודה", which puts two nouns in construct state with one shared complement; a native editor would rewrite it as "בעיבוד ובהרצה של עבודה".

examples.source: How to minimize the amount of usage spent processing and running a job.
examples.translation: כיצד למזער את כמות השימוש המושקע בעיבוד והרצת עבודה.
examples.suggested: כיצד לצמצם את זמן השימוש המוקדש לעיבוד ולהרצה של עבודה.
examples.why: 'כמות השימוש המושקע' copies 'amount of usage spent' word for word and sounds stiff. 'בעיבוד והרצת' puts two nouns in construct state with one shared complement, which is awkward Hebrew.

examples.source: There are several ways you can limit the amount of time spent processing and running a job:
examples.translation: ישנן מספר דרכים להגביל את כמות הזמן המושקע בעיבוד והרצת עבודה:
examples.suggested: יש כמה דרכים להגביל את הזמן המושקע בעיבוד ובהרצה של עבודה:
examples.why: 'כמות הזמן' copies 'amount of time', and the same construct-state problem appears again. 'יש כמה' is plainer and closer to the informal register.

editor_note: I found no semantic drift. The note limiting NoiseLearner to server-side EstimatorV2 and NoiseLearnerV3 to Executor and the client-side Estimator is correct in [8], and so are the InjectNoise ref/modifier_ref explanations in [31]–[33]. 'job' is rendered two ways: it stays in English as 'job' in [6], but becomes 'עבודה' in [11], [25], [26] and [33]. In [31], 'annotated boxes' becomes the awkward 'boxes מוערים', and the English-plural hybrid 'העבודה/ות' in [11] reads stiffly.

examples.source: after submitting one or more jobs through `qiskit-ibm-runtime`
examples.translation: לאחר שליחת job אחד או יותר דרך `qiskit-ibm-runtime`
examples.suggested: לאחר שליחת עבודה (job) אחת או יותר דרך `qiskit-ibm-runtime`
examples.why: 'job' stays in English here but is 'עבודה' in [11], [25], [26] and [33]. The term should be the same throughout the file.

examples.source: which groups instructions into annotated boxes
examples.translation: שמקבץ הוראות ל-boxes מוערים
examples.suggested: שמקבץ הוראות ל-boxes עם הערות (annotations)

examples.source: metadata about the job(s) submitted

examples.suggested: ומטא-נתונים על העבודות שהוגשו

editor_note: The translation is faithful and reads naturally. "Destinations" becomes יעדים, and "targets" and "routes" are told apart as יעדי ניתוב (targets) and מסלולים (routes). The trigger column of the table uses UI-style imperatives (קבל תצורת Backend, בטל עבודה, הרץ עבודה) that match the API operations correctly.

The translation is faithful and would not mislead a learner, but a native editor would still make a few small fixes. In [4], "versatile" became "רב-גונית", which means colorful or varied; "רב-תכליתית" is the usual word for a versatile framework. In [6], "על ידי הצטרפות" is a calque of the English "by joining". Also in [6], "ensuring everyone can play a role" became "ומבטיחים שלכל אחד יש תפקיד", which drops "can" and turns an opportunity into a guarantee that everyone has a role.

examples.source: introducing Qiskit, a versatile quantum computing framework
examples.translation: והצגת Qiskit, מסגרת עבודה רב-גונית למחשוב קוונטי
examples.suggested: והצגת Qiskit, מסגרת עבודה רב-תכליתית למחשוב קוונטי

examples.source: By joining the Qiskit community, you can participate in the development of quantum technologies.
examples.translation: על ידי הצטרפות לקהילת Qiskit, תוכל להשתתף בפיתוח טכנולוגיות קוונטיות.

examples.why: 'על ידי + noun' copies the English 'by joining'. A native writer would open with 'כש...' or 'בהצטרפות ל...'.

examples.source: ensuring everyone can play a role in advancing quantum technology
examples.translation: ומבטיחים שלכל אחד יש תפקיד בקידום הטכנולוגיה הקוונטית

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout, and nothing here would mislead a learner. The subsystem ordering for tensor/expand, compose vs. front=True, the global-phase caveat and the CP condition are all preserved. The problems are small. Entry [28] uses the non-word "ריכוב" instead of "הרכבה", and it also drops the definite article in "שהרכבה הקודמת". Entry [37] renders "approximately equal" as the stiff "הם בערך שווים", and "שווים בקירוב" reads more naturally. Two qualifiers are also dropped: "closely" in [23] and "reference" in [43].

examples.source: when composing with `front=True`
examples.translation: בעת ריכוב עם `front=True`
examples.suggested: בעת הרכבה עם `front=True` (and "שההרכבה הקודמת" at the start)
examples.why: "ריכוב" is not a Hebrew word. The file uses הרכבה/להרכיב everywhere else, so this looks like a typo that breaks the terminology.

examples.source: check if two operators are approximately equal
examples.translation: לבדיקה אם שני אופרטורים הם בערך שווים
examples.suggested: כדי לבדוק אם שני אופרטורים שווים בקירוב
examples.why: "בערך שווים" is colloquial and reads as a calque. The standard technical phrasing is "שווים בקירוב", and it should also replace "הוא בערך שווה" in [38].

examples.source: A closely related operation is `Operator.expand`
examples.translation: פעולה קשורה היא `Operator.expand`
examples.suggested: פעולה קשורה מאוד היא `Operator.expand`

examples.source: Explore the Operator API reference.
examples.translation: חקור את ה-Operator API.
examples.suggested: עיין בתיעוד העזר של ה-Operator API.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout, including the dim tuple caveat in [19], the 2^N by 2^M to M-qubit/N-qubit mapping in [21] and the 6x6 fallback in [22]. There are three wording problems. [20] says 'לרכוב אופרטורים', which means 'to ride operators'; it should be 'להרכיב'. [8] renders 'triplets' as 'טריאדות' where the natural word is 'שלשות'. [13] renders 'dot product' as 'המכפלה הפנימית' (inner product), but Pauli.dot does operator composition, so 'מכפלה' or 'הרכבה' would be more accurate.

examples.source: which can be used for composing operators together
examples.translation: שניתן להשתמש בהם לרכוב אופרטורים יחד
examples.suggested: שניתן להשתמש בהם להרכבת אופרטורים זה עם זה
examples.why: 'לרכוב' means 'to ride'. This is a wrong-word error, and 'להרכיב' / 'הרכבה' is what was meant.

examples.source: a list of (pauli_string, qubit_indices, coefficient) triplets
examples.translation: רשימה של טריאדות
examples.suggested: רשימה של שלשות
examples.why: 'שלשות' is the normal Hebrew word for tuples of three. 'טריאדות' reads as an odd calque.

examples.source: computing the dot product with another Pauli
examples.translation: וחישוב המכפלה הפנימית עם Pauli אחר
examples.suggested: וחישוב המכפלה (ההרכבה) עם Pauli אחר
examples.why: Pauli.dot returns the operator product, not a scalar. 'מכפלה פנימית' suggests an inner product.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout, and nothing would mislead a learner. The Sherrington-Kirkpatrick noise caveat in [21], the Market Split averaging and minimum-violation notes in [26], and the spin mapping in [51] all match the English. A native editor would still fix a few calques. In [12], "משם חומרת ה-IBM Quantum" is ambiguous, because "משם" also reads as "from there". "הדפסת התוצאות נותנת את הבא" in [46] and "מבצע אוטומציה של" in [7] are stiff, literal renderings. Terms are consistent: טרנספילציה, אנזץ, המילטוניאן, מהדר, and עיבוד לאחר-דגימה for post-processing.

examples.source: the chosen IBM Quantum hardware name
examples.translation: משם חומרת ה-IBM Quantum שנבחרה
examples.suggested: מהשם של חומרת ה-IBM Quantum שנבחרה

examples.translation: הדפסת התוצאות נותנת את הבא:
examples.suggested: הדפסת התוצאות מניבה את הפלט הבא:

examples.source: The Parity Twine Optimizer automates transpilation steps

examples.why: "מבצע אוטומציה של" is a stiff, literal rendering of the English verb. The suggested wording is a more natural way to say it in Hebrew.

examples.source: active Open Plan users can opt in to an additional 180 minutes over the next 12 months
examples.translation: משתמשי Open Plan פעילים יכולים להצטרף לתוספת של 180 דקות נוספות במהלך 12 החודשים הבאים

examples.source: exploring classical quantum algorithms and applications
examples.translation: חוקר אלגוריתמים קלאסיים-קוונטיים ויישומים
examples.suggested: חוקר אלגוריתמים ויישומים קוונטיים-קלאסיים

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The broadcasting rules, the note about commuting observables in separate PUBs, the example shapes (5x1, 1x6 with 4x1 giving 4x6, 3x6) and the BitArray axis description all match the English. examples.source: The `get_count` method returns a dictionary...

examples.suggested: המתודה `get_count` מחזירה מילון...

examples.translation: השילוב שלהם גורם למערך 4x6
examples.suggested: השילוב שלהם יוצר מערך 4x6

examples.source: When a circuit contains more than one classical register ... splitting the classical register into two distinct registers
examples.translation: כאשר Circuit מכיל יותר מ-ClassicalRegister אחד ... פיצול ה-ClassicalRegister לשני registers נפרדים

examples.source: to create the resulting expectation value estimates
examples.translation: כדי ליצור הערכות ערך ציפייה מתקבלות
examples.suggested: כדי לקבל את הערכות ערכי הציפייה המתאימות

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. The V1/V2 caveat, the claim that the primitives supersede backend.run, and the description of the Backend*V2 wrappers all match the English, so nothing here would mislead a learner. The problems are Hebrew grammar and word choice. There is a non-word in [34] ("ובדיכוין" should be "ובדיכוי"). Several words have the wrong grammatical gender: "עלתה שוב הצורך" in [8], "אותה מבנה" in [25] and "זה לא היה בעיה" in [7]. A definite article is missing in "לבחירת מחשב הקוונטי" in [29]. "API references" is rendered as "עזרי ה-API" in [31], [32] and [37], which is unidiomatic.

examples.source: advancements in error mitigation and suppression
examples.translation: בהפחתת שגיאות ובדיכוין
examples.suggested: בהפחתת שגיאות ובדיכוין
examples.why: 'דיכוין' is not a Hebrew word. It is a typo for 'דיכוי' (suppression).

examples.source: again the need for a higher-level abstraction emerged

editor_note: Faithful and natural throughout, with consistent terms (fractional gates→שערים שברירתיים, deprecated→סומנה כמיושנת (deprecated), calibration→כיול). The deprecation timeline in [3] and the requirement in [6] to load both R_X and R_ZZ with the use_fractional_gates flag both keep their exact meaning.

Nothing here would mislead a learner. The numbers, the caveats (classical processing time still counts, the qubit counts are not hard limits) and the benchmark definitions all carry over faithfully. The problem is register: the body addresses the reader in the plural (ראו, צרו, הריצו), but from [56] on it switches to the masculine singular (צור, בקש, בקר, נסה, ראה), and 'Review X' comes out as the unidiomatic 'ראה ב-X'. There are also a few smaller slips. 'primitive' is written three ways (פרימיטיב, פרימיטיבי, and 'primitive' left in English). 'swap in the Q-CTRL Sampler and Estimator' reads ambiguously as replacing them. 'automated by' became 'שמאפשר' ('enabled by'). 'hard limitation' / 'testing … is encouraged' are word-for-word calques.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout: support levels, the "strongly discouraged" aliasing caveat, the July 2025 / v0.6.0 limits and the hardware restrictions all match the English. The worst problems are in note 7 [24]. "gate modifiers" appears twice as "מגדלי Gate", which reads as "gate towers" and should be "משני Gate". "eagerly evaluate" became "יעריך בנחישות" ("will evaluate with determination"), which loses the eager-evaluation idea. There are smaller slips too: "ייבאן" in [26] is a malformed word for "המייבא"; "not eligible" is calqued as "אינה/אינם זכאית/זכאים" in [25] and [26]; and the page switches from plural imperatives ("ראו") to masculine-singular ones ("למד", "ראה") in the Next steps box.

editor_note: Meaning holds throughout. The removed/alternative tables, the V1-to-V2 primitives migration, the "**not** migrated" caveat in [152] and the no-alternative statements all match the source. The problems are word choice and consistency. "observable" appears as both "אובזרבבל" ([76], [104]) and Latin "observable" ([84], [105]). "circuit" is "מעגלים" in [76] but "Circuit(s)" elsewhere, and primitives is "פרימיטיבים" vs "primitives". [32] renders "Pygments-colored output" as "פלט מצויר" ("drawn"), and [13] uses the ambiguous unvocalized "השמות" for "assignments", which reads first as "the names". "some differences" becomes "הבדלים קטנים" in [140], which slightly downplays the import-path changes, and a few phrasings are stiff ("אמפליטודה pulse" [168], "הפאזה של גם X וגם Y" [208]). Mapping "right side" to "צד שמאל" in [4] is a correct RTL localization, not a defect.

examples.suggested: אך יש כמה הבדלים בנתיב הייבוא

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout and nothing would mislead a learner, but a native editor would still change a few things. In [93], "this is likely because" loses its "likely" ("הסיבה לכך היא"), so a probable cause reads as a certain one. In [129]–[131], "the dependent" (the package that depends on qiskit-terra) becomes "התלות" (the dependency), which blurs which package is meant. The rest is calque and odd word choice: "lowest indentation" becomes "הכנסה" (which can read as "income") instead of "הזחה" [127]; "shell session" becomes "שיחת ה-shell" [88]; "will mean" becomes "יאמר" [31/116]; and "editable installations" becomes "התקנות עריכה" [145].

examples.source: this is likely because one of the distributions you are trying to install contains a requirement like `qiskit<1.0`
examples.translation: הסיבה לכך היא שאחת ההפצות שאתה מנסה להתקין מכילה דרישה כמו `qiskit<1.0`
examples.suggested: הסיבה לכך היא כנראה שאחת ההפצות...
examples.why: The hedge 'likely' is dropped, so a probable cause is stated as certain.

examples.source: The dependent is an old package, and will not be updated to support Qiskit v1.0.
examples.translation: התלות היא חבילה ישנה, ולא תתעדכן לתמיכה ב-Qiskit v1.0.
examples.suggested: החבילה התלויה היא חבילה ישנה, ולא תתעדכן לתמיכה ב-Qiskit v1.0.
examples.why: 'Dependent' (the package that depends on qiskit-terra) is rendered as 'dependency', which reverses the relationship. The same happens in [130] and [131].

examples.source: (lowest indentation)
examples.translation: (הכנסה הנמוכה ביותר)
examples.suggested: (ההזחה הקטנה ביותר)

examples.source: the directory your shell session was in

examples.suggested: הספרייה שבה היה סשן ה-shell שלך

editor_note: Faithful and natural throughout: "does break compatibility with all previous versions" keeps its full scope as "שובר תאימות עם כל הגרסאות הקודמות", and the three link purposes (installation, feature changes, breaking package changes → "שינויים שוברי-תאימות בחבילות") are rendered accurately.

The meaning is faithful throughout. I found no misleading drift in the c_if removal, the duration/Target explanation, the transpiler migration list or the pulse-removal support dates. There are a few naturalness and consistency slips. 'Gate' appears as 'Gate' everywhere except 'משכי שער' in [45], and 'alternative' is rendered as both 'אלטרנטיבה' and 'חלופה'. 'Expressive' is calqued as the awkward 'ביטויית' in [14] and [28], and the coined verb 'אנדקס' in [22] and 'לעבור ממנו' for 'move away from it' in [23] read as translationese.

editor_note: I found no meaning drift. Conditions, numbers, dates, version caveats and the deprecated/maintained distinction all match the English, so nothing here would mislead a learner. The problems are local slips a native editor would fix. "releases page" became "דף ההוצאות", which reads as "expenses/publications page". "לאתגרתי" [11] is not a real word. "מבלי לצורך ליצור" [40] is ungrammatical. "adopters" became the calque "מאמצים חדשים" [4]. The accordion title in [28] was left entirely in English while its sibling titles [65]/[70] are translated. The reader is addressed as singular "שלך/תוכל" throughout except [66], which switches to plural "לכם", and "seed" is rendered literally as "הזרע" [81].

examples.source: Download pre-built binaries from the [releases page]

examples.suggested: הורד קבצים בינאריים מוכנים מראש מ[דף הגרסאות (Releases)]

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout and nothing would mislead a learner: expectation values→ערכי ציפייה, Executor's beta status, and "additional capabilities that Sampler does not offer" all come through correctly. editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. Version rules, T1/T2, the SPAM definitions of prob_meas, EPLG and its 4/5 factor, and the error = 1 caveat all match the English, so nothing here would mislead a learner. The problems are polish. [69]/[71] use the ungrammatical "כאשר התכוון להכין אותו", which has no subject.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. The benchmark numbers, the three Bernstein-Vazirani configurations, the ratio formula and the "lower is better" caveats all match the English, so nothing here would mislead a learner. What a native editor would still fix: "readout-mitigation" in [12] became "הפחתת קריאה" ("reducing readout"), which drops the word for errors. "Representative runs" in [22] is calqued as "הרצות נציגות" instead of "מייצגות". "Benchmark" is rendered three ways: "אמות מידה", "בנצ'מרקים" and "benchmarking". The heading in [44] and "aligns circuits with" in [6] read as stiff, word-for-word translation. The recurring "פריקת צימוד דינמית" for dynamical decoupling is used consistently, but "פריקה" is an unusual word for "decoupling".

examples.suggested: מסכמות הרצות מייצגות של Orbit

examples.translation: אמות מידה (Benchmarks)
examples.suggested: בנצ'מרקים
examples.why: The same term appears as 'אמות מידה' here, 'בנצ'מרקים' in [22] and [70], and untranslated 'benchmarking' in [19]. Pick one.

examples.why: This is a word-for-word calque. 'ברירות מחדל של גולמי' is ungrammatical and hides the two modes being compared.

examples.source: better aligns circuits with the target hardware connectivity
examples.translation: ומיישרת טוב יותר את המעגלים עם קישוריות החומרה היעד

examples.why: 'מיישרת ... עם' is a calque of 'aligns with'. 'החומרה היעד' is also a broken construct state and should be 'חומרת היעד'.

editor_note: Nothing in the translation would mislead a learner. The rep_delay trade-off in [10] (lower delay means shorter QPU time but a higher state-preparation error rate), the rep_delay=0 plus init_qubits=False merge caveat in [12] and both "no guarantee" caveats in [13] all come through accurately. A native editor would still fix three things. The grammatical gender of "Circuits" changes between entries: masculine "מקובצים" in [8] and feminine "מקובצות" in [13]. "אין ערובה על סדר" is a calque and should be "אין ערובה לגבי סדר". "הוא מוגדר לאזן" in [7] reads stiffly.

examples.source: there is no guarantee on the order the circuits from PUBs are executed
examples.translation: שים לב שבעוד ש-Circuits בעבודת פרימיטיב מקובצות יחד לביצוע QPU, אין ערובה על סדר ביצוע ה-Circuits מ-PUBs
examples.suggested: שים לב שאף ש-Circuits בעבודת פרימיטיב מקובצים יחד לביצוע על ה-QPU, אין ערובה לגבי הסדר שבו ה-Circuits מה-PUBs מבוצעים
examples.why: In Hebrew you give a guarantee "לגבי" something, not "על" it. The feminine "מקובצות" also clashes with the masculine "מקובצים" used for the same noun in [8].

examples.source: it's usually set to balance reset fidelity against total execution time
examples.translation: אך בדרך כלל הוא מוגדר לאזן בין נאמנות האיפוס (fidelity) לבין זמן הביצוע הכולל
examples.suggested: אך בדרך כלל הוא נקבע כך שיאזן בין נאמנות האיפוס (fidelity) לבין זמן הביצוע הכולל
examples.why: "מוגדר לאזן" copies the English "set to balance" word for word. A Hebrew technical writer would write "נקבע כך ש..." or "נועד לאזן".

examples.source: These circuits are executed by iterating over the circuits for each shot requested
examples.translation: ה-Circuits הללו מבוצעים על ידי איטרציה על ה-Circuits לכל shot שהתבקש
examples.suggested: ה-Circuits האלה מבוצעים באיטרציה על כל ה-Circuits עבור כל shot שהתבקש
examples.why: "על ידי איטרציה על" is translationese built on the English passive. Plain "באיטרציה" reads more naturally.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. Coupling map (מפת קישוריות), layout/routing and the error-rate sections all match the English, and I found no drift or invented claims. A few calques would read oddly to a native technical editor. In [25], "introducing SWAP gates" became "הצגת Gate SWAP", which means presenting or displaying them, not inserting them; it should be "הוספת". In [40], "native gates" became "ילידיות", an unnatural term here; "מקוריות" or "טבעיות" would read better. In [50], "ראה בנושא" is ungrammatical and should be "עיין בנושא".

examples.source: by introducing SWAP gates to move the quantum information around
examples.translation: על ידי הצגת Gate SWAP להזזת המידע הקוונטי
examples.suggested: על ידי הוספת Gate SWAP להזזת המידע הקוונטי
examples.why: The word "הצגת" means displaying or presenting. It is a calque of "introducing" in the wrong sense: the gates are inserted into the circuit.

examples.source: native gates and operations
examples.translation: Gate ופעולות ילידיות אפשריות
examples.suggested: Gate ופעולות מקוריות (native) אפשריות
examples.why: "ילידיות" (indigenous) is unnatural for hardware-native gates. Also, "possible" has moved: the English says "the list of possible native gates", but the Hebrew has "possible" describing the gates themselves.

examples.source: Review the [Commonly used parameters for transpilation] topic.
examples.translation: ראה בנושא [פרמטרים נפוצים לשימוש ב-Transpilation]
examples.suggested: עיין בנושא [פרמטרים נפוצים ל-Transpilation]
examples.why: "ראה בנושא" is ungrammatical. The natural imperative with this preposition is "עיין ב...".

examples.source: the two-qubit gates can only go in one direction
examples.translation: Gate דו-Qubit יכולים לנוע רק בכיוון אחד
examples.suggested: Gate דו-Qubit ניתנים להפעלה רק בכיוון אחד
examples.why: "לנוע" (move) is a literal calque of "go". Gates don't move; they can only be applied in one direction.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. Every IBM-vs-customer split, the "IBM is not responsible for backup" caveats and the encryption scope all carry over correctly, so nothing here would mislead a learner. A native editor would still change three things. First, "Rotate ... your API keys" became "סב ועדכן", which is an obscure, barely readable imperative. Second, the "Your responsibilities" column switches between imperatives (הגדר, עקוב, שמור, הגבל) and infinitives (להעניק, לנטר, להבטיח, לשלוח מחדש) from row to row. Third, "security section of the Qiskit GitHub repository" was rendered as "סעיף האבטחה", which is a document-section calque for what is a tab or area of the repository.

examples.source: Rotate and update your API keys according to your security policy requirements.
examples.translation: סב ועדכן את מפתחות ה-API שלך בהתאם לדרישות מדיניות האבטחה שלך.

examples.why: 'סב' is an obscure imperative that most readers won't parse as key rotation. Hebrew security writing says 'החלפה תקופתית' or 'רוטציה'.

examples.source: Ensure that personal and regulated data is not provided. / Restrict user access ...

examples.suggested: Use one form for the whole column, e.g. the infinitive throughout: להבטיח ... / להגביל גישת משתמש ...
examples.why: The customer-responsibility column alternates between infinitive and imperative across rows and tables, so the tables read unevenly.

examples.source: Check the security section of the Qiskit GitHub repository.
examples.translation: בדוק את סעיף האבטחה של מאגר GitHub של Qiskit.
examples.suggested: בדוק את אזור האבטחה (Security) במאגר ה-GitHub של Qiskit.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful and nothing would mislead a learner, but some wording needs fixing. In [34], "put into ... status" became "מועמד למצב", which uses the wrong word ("candidate"); it should be "מועבר למצב". [24] and [45] render "determine" as "קביעת/לקבוע", which reads as "set" when the text means "find out" (לברר). Terms are inconsistent: job/batch mode is "מצב עבודה/מצב אצווה" in [6] but "מצב job/מצב batch" in [14], and "context manager" is Hebrew elsewhere but English in [35]. There are also calques and a grammar slip: "זמן המקסימום לחיות" in [19], "אותה חלון" (חלון is masculine) in [21], and "outstanding" rendered as "פעילות" in [42].

examples.source: the session is put into "In progress, not accepting new jobs" status

examples.suggested: ה-session מועבר למצב "In progress, not accepting new jobs"

examples.source: To determine a session's max TTL or interactive TTL ... look for the max_time or interactive_timeout value

examples.source: run only in job mode or batch mode
examples.translation: יכולים לרוץ רק ב[מצב job] או ב[מצב batch]
examples.suggested: יכולים לרוץ רק ב[מצב עבודה] או ב[מצב אצווה]
examples.why: [6] already translates these as מצב עבודה/מצב אצווה, so the same page uses two different terms for the same thing.

examples.source: If no session jobs are queued within that window
examples.translation: אם אין עבודות session בתור בתוך אותה חלון
examples.suggested: אם אין עבודות session בתור בתוך אותו חלון זמן
examples.why: This is a gender agreement error, since חלון is masculine.

examples.source: The maximum session time to live (TTL)
examples.translation: זמן המקסימום לחיות (TTL) של ה-session
examples.suggested: זמן החיים המקסימלי (TTL) של ה-session
examples.why: 'זמן המקסימום לחיות' is a word-for-word calque that a Hebrew speaker would not write.

editor_note: Nothing here would mislead a learner. Every point of meaning checks out against the English: the Unset/server-default behavior, the primitive copying its options so later changes to the original don't affect it, and no need to instantiate EstimatorOptions/SamplerOptions after initialization. Terminology is consistent throughout (primitive kept in English, options class→מחלקת אפשרויות, dictionary→מילון, instance→מופע, error suppression/mitigation→דיכוי/הפחתת שגיאות). The one thing a native editor would change is "bulk updates" in [24]. It is rendered as "עדכונים בכמות גדולה", which suggests a large volume of updates rather than several options updated in one call. "עדכון מרוכז" / "עדכון של כמה אפשרויות בבת אחת" says it better.

"iterable list" is calqued as "ניתנת לחזרה", and "post-processing" as the stiff "עיבוד לאחר". There is also a typo in [31] ("ספקת" should be "אספקת"), and the imperatives switch from plural "לכם" to singular masculine "ראה/עיין/הצג/חלץ".

examples.source: an example set of vectorized inputs

examples.source: an iterable list of SamplerPubResult objects ... calling the RuntimeJobV2.result() method

examples.source: for performant post-processing
examples.translation: לעיבוד לאחר יעיל
examples.suggested: לעיבוד-המשך יעיל של התוצאות

examples.source: by providing an ExecutionSpan.mask method
examples.translation: על ידי ספקת שיטת
examples.suggested: באמצעות המתודה

editor_note: The meaning is faithful, the terms are consistent (error mitigation/suppression→הפחתת/דיכוי שגיאות, overhead→תקורת עיבוד מקדים, execution mode→מצב הרצה), and the informal "ראו/למדו" register holds throughout; entry [0] keeps the upstream's "Estimator" slip exactly as the source has it.

The meaning is faithful throughout. The shots precedence order [18]-[23], the twirling failure caveat [24] and the compatibility notes [100]-[103] all match the source, so nothing here would mislead a learner. examples.source: Compatible with fractional gates
examples.translation: תואם לשערים שברייים
examples.suggested: תואם לשערים שבריים
examples.why: This is a spelling error (three yods), and it repeats in the accordion title and in [102].

examples.source: accepts two arguments
examples.translation: מקבלת שתי ארגומנטים
examples.suggested: מקבלת שני ארגומנטים

examples.source: Does not work with non-Clifford entanglers.
examples.translation: לא עובד עם משלבים שאינם Clifford.
examples.suggested: לא עובד עם שערי שזירה שאינם Clifford.

examples.source: customize the Sampler primitive ... the primitives' run() method
examples.translation: את ה-primitive Sampler ... השיטה `run()`
examples.suggested: את הפרימיטיב Sampler ... המתודה `run()`
examples.why: [0] uses 'פרימיטיב' and [105] uses 'מתודות'. The same concepts should be rendered the same way throughout the file.

examples.source: see the Introduction to options topic
examples.translation: ראה את הנושא
examples.suggested: ראו את הנושא
examples.why: [6] addresses the reader in the plural ('תוכלו'), but [9], [99] and [105] switch to the masculine singular imperative.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through, including the Sampler V2 caveat that resilience levels are unsupported in [21] and the Open Plan session restriction in [35]. A few slips remain that a native editor would fix. In [22], "האפשרויות ברירת המחדל" is ungrammatical and should be "אפשרויות ברירת המחדל". In [14], PUB data "broadcasted" to a circuit comes out as "המשודרים", a word for radio-style transmission, not array broadcasting. There are also calques: "מצא פרטים על כיצד" in [8] and [28], "תיעוד הפניית API" for "API reference" in [5], and the product name IBM Quantum Learning rendered as "לימוד IBM Quantum" in [35].

examples.source: demonstrate the default options for dynamical decoupling and twirling
examples.translation: מדגימות את האפשרויות ברירת המחדל עבור dynamical decoupling
examples.suggested: מדגימות את אפשרויות ברירת המחדל של dynamical decoupling ו-twirling
examples.why: The definite article on the construct noun is ungrammatical in Hebrew.

examples.source: the data broadcasted to that circuit
examples.translation: והנתונים המשודרים לאותו מעגל
examples.suggested: והנתונים שמוחלים (broadcast) על אותו מעגל
examples.why: משודרים means transmitted, as in radio. The source means NumPy-style broadcasting of parameter values over the circuit.

examples.source: Find details on how to initialize your account
examples.translation: מצא פרטים על כיצד לאתחל את החשבון שלך
examples.suggested: פרטים על אתחול החשבון, ... מופיעים ב
examples.why: "על כיצד" is a calque of "on how". Native Hebrew uses "על אופן" or a noun phrase.

examples.source: Refer to the [API reference documentation]
examples.translation: עיין ב[תיעוד הפניית API]
examples.suggested: עיין ב[תיעוד העיון של ה-API]
examples.why: "הפניית" means redirection or referral, not reference documentation.

examples.source: in IBM Quantum Learning
examples.translation: בלימוד IBM Quantum
examples.suggested: ב-IBM Quantum Learning
examples.why: This is a product name. Half-translating it makes it unrecognizable.

editor_note: The translation is faithful and reads naturally, and every caveat is kept: "encrypted at rest" becomes "מוצפנים במצב מנוחה (בזמן אחסון)", "(undeleted) data for three years" becomes "(שלא נמחקו) למשך שלוש שנים", and the Manager-role condition stays a condition.

The meaning is faithful all the way through. The limit to serializable inputs in [27], the wrapper linkage caveat in [31] and the optional arguments in [32] all come through intact, and the terminology is used consistently (transpile, backend, job→עבודה, authenticate→הזדהות מול). examples.source: and will load your default saved account unless you specify otherwise
examples.translation: וייטען את החשבון השמור כברירת מחדל שלך אלא אם תציין אחרת

examples.source: deploy it to IBM Quantum Platform to use as a reusable remote service
examples.translation: ולפרוס אותה ל-IBM Quantum Platform לשימוש כשירות מרוחק לשימוש חוזר
examples.suggested: ולפרוס אותה ל-IBM Quantum Platform כשירות מרוחק רב-פעמי
examples.why: The doubled לשימוש is a calque of 'to use as a reusable' and reads as stiff translationese. The same phrasing appears again in [7].

examples.source: Initialize your IBM Quantum Compute Service account
examples.translation: אתחול חשבון שירות IBM Quantum Compute Service שלך
examples.suggested: אתחול חשבון IBM Quantum Compute Service שלך

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. Statuses, CPU/memory allocation (16 cores / 32 GB, 2*1024^3 bytes) and the /data limits (tar/h5 only, no subdirectories) all match the English, so nothing here would mislead a learner. A native editor would still fix several calques. "לרשום את כל הקבצים" in [29] is a literal "list" and reads as "register/write down". "לתקשר עם הקבצים" in [31] is a literal "interact with". "זה כולל מספר מגבלות" in [25] and the awkward passive "ונעקבות במסגרתה" in [18] also read as translated. examples.source: Next, you can list all the files in your `data` directory.
examples.translation: לאחר מכן, תוכל לרשום את כל הקבצים בספריית `data` שלך.

examples.suggested: חלות על כך כמה מגבלות:

examples.source: How to set the optimization level for transpiling quantum circuits in Qiskit.
examples.translation: כיצד להגדיר את רמת האופטימיזציה עבור transpiling מעגלים קוונטיים ב-Qiskit.
examples.suggested: כיצד להגדיר את רמת האופטימיזציה לביצוע transpile למעגלים קוונטיים ב-Qiskit.
examples.why: An English gerund dropped into Hebrew syntax is a calque. It reads as mixed-language MT.

examples.source: an input circuit consisting of a random unitary followed by a SWAP gate
examples.translation: מעגל קלט המורכב מ-unitary אקראי אחריו Gate SWAP
examples.suggested: מעגל קלט המורכב מ-unitary אקראי ואחריו Gate SWAP
examples.why: The conjunction or relative pronoun is missing, so the phrase is ungrammatical in Hebrew.

examples.source: Next steps
examples.translation: צעדים הבאים
examples.suggested: הצעדים הבאים
examples.why: A definite adjective needs a definite noun. Without the article the heading reads as ungrammatical.

examples.source: The transpiled circuit has six of the two-qubit ECR gates.
examples.translation: למעגל שעבר transpile יש שישה Gate ECR דו-קיוביטיים.
examples.suggested: למעגל שעבר transpile יש שישה Gateים מסוג ECR דו-קיוביטיים.
examples.why: The plural of Gate is inconsistent: bare "Gate" here and in [17], [23] and [25], but "Gateים" in [9], [17] and [7].

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The depolarizing-channel reasoning in [16], the 65% "conservative estimate" caveat in [18] and the claim in [11] that two-qubit gates dominate the error all come through intact. There are four small things a native editor would fix. In [11], "השגיאה ... הם המקור הדומיננטי" has a number-agreement error (it should be "היא"). "Qubit" is written three ways: "qubit" in [8], "Qubit" in [16] and the Hebrew adjective "דו-קיוביטיים" in [11]. In [21], "ראה בתיעוד" is a weak rendering of "Review the documentation", and "מילון הממפה שמות Gate לספירות" in [17] is stiff.

examples.source: the error arising from the two-qubit gates, which are CX gates here, are the dominant source of error
examples.translation: השגיאה הנובעת מ-Gateים דו-קיוביטיים, שהם Gate CX כאן, הם המקור הדומיננטי לשגיאה
examples.suggested: השגיאה הנובעת משערים דו-קיוביטיים (כאן, שערי CX) היא המקור הדומיננטי לשגיאה
examples.why: The subject is singular (השגיאה) but the verb is plural (הם). This copies the English agreement error instead of correcting it.

examples.source: create an example circuit on eight qubits
examples.translation: צור מעגל דוגמה על שמונה qubit
examples.suggested: צור מעגל לדוגמה על שמונה קיוביטים
examples.why: "Qubit" appears as lowercase "qubit" here, "Qubit" in [16] and Hebrew "קיוביט" in [11]. It also lacks the plural after a number.

examples.source: Review the [Qiskit Aer] documentation.
examples.translation: ראה בתיעוד [Qiskit Aer].
examples.suggested: עיין בתיעוד של [Qiskit Aer].
examples.why: "ראה בתיעוד" reads as a truncated cross-reference. "עיין ב..." is the natural way to say "review the docs".

examples.source: a dictionary that maps gate names to counts
examples.translation: מילון הממפה שמות Gate לספירות
examples.suggested: מילון שממפה שמות של שערים למספר המופעים שלהם
examples.why: "לספירות" is a literal calque of "counts". Here the meaning is the number of times each gate occurs.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. The Estimator and Sampler rules are kept the right way round (no measurements for Estimator, measurements required for Sampler), and so are the precision/shots defaults and the PUB-level options. The problems are phrasing only. The Estimator note [12] says "חייב **שלא** לכלול", a calque of "must not" that a native writer would put as "אסור ש...יכלול". "Circuit" is also split within the file: native "מעגלים קוונטיים", "מעגלים דינמיים" and "מעגלי ISA" sit next to the English kept term, sometimes in the same entry ([15]). Entry [30] adds "של מצבי הפלט" to the output distributions, which then repeats as "מצבי פלט" at the end of the sentence.

examples.source: Any circuit passed to an Estimator must **not** include any **measurements**.
examples.translation: כל Circuit שמועבר ל-Estimator חייב **שלא** לכלול **מדידות**.
examples.suggested: אסור שמעגל שמועבר ל-Estimator יכלול **מדידות** כלשהן.
examples.why: 'חייב שלא' is a calque of 'must not'. The meaning survives, but in Hebrew the natural way to state a prohibition is 'אסור'.

examples.source: (referred to as *instruction set architecture (ISA)* circuits and observables)
examples.translation: דורשת ש-Circuit וה-observables יומרו ... (המכונות מעגלי *instruction set architecture (ISA)* ו-observables)
examples.suggested: Use one rendering for circuit throughout, e.g. 'מעגלים' / 'מעגלי ISA'.
examples.why: The same entry uses both 'Circuit' and 'מעגלי' for circuit, and [34] then says 'ISA circuits' in English. The split is inconsistent but the concept stays recognizable.

examples.source: returns the results from sampling from the output probability distributions as a quasi-probability distribution of output states.
examples.translation: ומחזירה את התוצאות מדגימה מהתפלגויות ההסתברות של מצבי הפלט כהתפלגות קוואזי-הסתברות של מצבי פלט.
examples.suggested: ומחזירה את תוצאות הדגימה מהתפלגויות ההסתברות של הפלט, כהתפלגות קוואזי-הסתברותית של מצבי הפלט.
examples.why: The added 'של מצבי הפלט' repeats 'מצבי פלט' later in the same sentence, and 'תוצאות מדגימה' reads stiffly.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout: the remainder going to the first delay, the negative-delay constraint and the billing caveat all come through intact, so nothing would mislead a learner. There are a few phrasing problems. [30] is ungrammatical: "הערכים המוחזרים עבור משך התלויים" wrongly attaches "depend" to "duration". "Resolve to" is rendered unnaturally, as "מתפרש לערך" in [16] and "להתפתח לערכי delay" in [61]. "Sliders" is rendered as "גוררים", where "מחוונים" is the usual word. Gate is also written once as "שער ה-x" in [35], while the rest of the file uses Gate.

examples.source: The values returned for duration depend on the goal value and the calculated remainder.
examples.translation: הערכים המוחזרים עבור משך התלויים בערך המטרה ובשארית המחושבת.
examples.suggested: ערכי המשך המוחזרים תלויים בערך המטרה ובשארית המחושבת.
examples.why: The definite 'התלויים' turns the main verb into a relative clause, so the sentence has no predicate and reads as broken.

examples.source: Stretch expressions cannot resolve to negative delay values.
examples.translation: ביטויי stretch לא יכולים להתפתח לערכי delay שליליים.
examples.suggested: ביטויי stretch לא יכולים להיפתר לערכי delay שליליים.
examples.why: 'להתפתח' means 'develop/evolve'. The page elsewhere uses 'פתרון/נפתר' for resolution, so this should match.

examples.source: The above code resolves to a value of 25 with a remainder of 1. The first delay`[a]` will have the remainder added.
examples.translation: הקוד לעיל מתפרש לערך 25 עם שארית של 1. ה-delay הראשון `[a]` יקבל את השארית המוספת.
examples.suggested: הקוד לעיל נפתר לערך 25 עם שארית של 1. השארית מתווספת ל-delay הראשון `[a]`.
examples.why: 'מתפרש' means 'is interpreted', which breaks the file's resolution terminology, and 'יקבל את השארית המוספת' is a stiff calque.

examples.source: Use the sliders at the bottom
examples.translation: השתמש בגוררים שבתחתית
examples.suggested: השתמש במחוונים שבתחתית
examples.why: 'גוררים' is not the conventional Hebrew UI term for sliders. The usual word is 'מחוונים'.
